classification.difficultyReason: Apply equal perpendicular distances across horizontal, vertical and diagonal axes, recognising fixed points and preserving connections; the hardest cases distinguish an unchanged circle from its reflected radius and reflect arrow directions.

inlines.text: Reflect each figure in the given axis of reflection. (In each diagram, the axis of reflection is marked with an arrow at each end.) Remember to label your images in the proper way.
